personas.name: completionist mapper
personas.goal: Visit every floor area, collect every coin, gem, relic, key and heart, open every locked door, and finish the level with the maximum possible score and time bonus.
personas.style: Plays methodically with goto: macros to each unexplored region, sweeps the 14x10 grid row by row, and uses the lever to test both gate states. Before finishing, checks that coins n/5 and keys match the map. Watches for items that reappear after collection.

personas.name: sequence-breaker
personas.goal: Reach the exit or other outcomes early or by unintended routes: dash through locked doors and gates, reach the exit before collecting keys, use the lever out of order, and trigger timer or game-over paths on purpose.
personas.style: Uses dash-* tokens in every direction from odd positions, including into walls and closed doors to test the zero-tile dash rule. Uses same-tick combinations such as down+dash-right. Tries to finish without the keys needed for doors and checks that the rules still hold.

personas.name: chaos tester
personas.goal: Break timing: press pause, esc, enter, click buttons and movement keys during transitions such as collecting an item, taking a hit, a respawn, the final exit step, and the game-over moment. Also spams input to find input races.
personas.style: Sends multi-key tokens like pause+left, esc+up, enter+right and wait bursts. Pauses on the tick a coin, spike or enemy contact happens. Clicks Resume and Restart level repeatedly and in both orders. Pushes many tokens fast with no pauses between them.

personas.name: literal newcomer
personas.goal: Follow the design document one sentence at a time and check each sentence literally, including the map legend, the order of actions in a running tick, the 5-coin total, the 5-lives cap, the 300-tick timer and the Dash recharge of 6.
personas.style: Reads every rule as a spec and writes one observation per sentence. Starts from a fresh game and walks the exact start-to-exit path. Confirms the HUD text ('Dash 5', 'Dash ready', 'Coins n/5') after each action and compares it to state.

personas.name: economy auditor
personas.goal: Drive score, lives, keys, coins and timer to their limits: reach 0 score under spikes, reach 5 lives and collect hearts, reach the 999,999 cap, and let the timer run out. Check every amount against the rules.
personas.style: Stacks high-value items (relic, gem) and spikes in different orders. Holds at 5 lives to test the +500 heart substitute. Lets the timer run to 0 on purpose and checks the life loss and reset to 300. Records the score delta for every tick and checks it against the item table.

personas.name: photographer
personas.goal: Open every dialog and menu (pause menu, Level complete, Game over, victory) and check what text is shown, which buttons are visible, and whether each visible button is actually clickable (top flag true).
personas.style: Opens the pause menu, closes it with each of P, Escape, Enter and Resume, and compares the dialog text to state.mode. Reaches Level complete, Finish, Play again, Game over and Retry. At each dialog, checks every visible button's rectangle and top flag and clicks each one once.

checks.rule: Score is never negative and is capped at 999,999.
The player has at most 5 lives and never negative lives.
Lives reach 0 only in the game-over state.
Coins are between 0 and the level's 5 coins.
The HUD Lives field always shows the current lives.
The HUD Keys field always shows the current keys.
The HUD Coins field shows the current coin count as n/5.
The HUD Time field shows the ticks left on the timer.
The HUD Score field shows the current score (checked while the score has no thousands separator).
The dash status shows 'Dash ready' when the recharge is 0 and 'Dash n' with n the ticks left otherwise.
Dash recharge is between 0 and 6, and dashReady is true exactly when it is 0.
The timer is between 0 and 300.
The timer drops by exactly 1 at the end of every running tick (no life lost, no completion this tick).
checks.when: prev.state.mode == 'playing' && cur.state.mode == 'playing' && cur.state.clock == prev.state.clock + 1 && cur.state.lives == prev.state.lives && prev.state.timeLeft > 1

checks.rule: While paused nothing moves: player, timer, dash recharge, toast and clock are frozen.
checks.expect: cur.state.player.x == prev.state.player.x && cur.state.player.y == prev.state.player.y && cur.state.timeLeft == prev.state.timeLeft && cur.state.dashCooldown == prev.state.dashCooldown && cur.state.toast == prev.state.toast && cur.state.clock == prev.state.clock

checks.rule: At most one move per tick: a step is one tile, a dash is at most two tiles in a straight line.
checks.expect: abs(cur.state.player.x - prev.state.player.x) + abs(cur.state.player.y - prev.state.player.y) <= 2 && (cur.state.player.x == prev.state.player.x || cur.state.player.y == prev.state.player.y)

checks.rule: The player stays inside the 14 x 10 grid.
The player never stands on a wall or on a locked door tile (an opened door shows '/').
checks.expect: tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != '#' && tile(cur, cur.state.player.x, cur.state.player.y) != 'D'

checks.rule: Walking into a locked door with a key opens it and uses exactly one key.
Each coin adds 100 score and each coin counter increment adds exactly one coin.
Spikes cost 500 points (score never goes below 0) and one life.
Score only decreases through spikes or a restart.
A heart gives +1 life up to 5; at 5 lives it gives +500 score instead and lives stay at 5.
Ending a tick on an enemy's tile (outside invulnerability and respawn) costs one life.
checks.expect: !any(cur.state.enemies, e => e.x == cur.state.player.x && e.y == cur.state.player.y) || includes(cur.state.events,'hit')

checks.rule: Invulnerability counts down from at most 4 after a respawn and is never negative.
After losing a life the player reappears at (1,1) and keeps all collected items.
checks.expect: cur.state.player.x == 1 && cur.state.player.y == 1 && cur.state.keys >= prev.state.keys && cur.state.coins >= prev.state.coins

checks.rule: Restart level restores score 0, 3 lives, all items back, timer 300 and the game running.
checks.expect: cur.state.score == 0 && cur.state.lives == 3 && cur.state.keys == 0 && cur.state.coins == 0 && cur.state.timeLeft == 300 && cur.state.mode == 'playing'

checks.rule: Stepping onto the exit shows the 'Level complete!' dialog with a Finish button and the time bonus is 10 per tick left.
checks.expect: any(cur.ui, u => u.kind == 'dialog' && u.visible && includes(u.text, 'Level complete')) && cur.state.bonus == 10 * cur.state.timeLeft

checks.rule: In the paused state the pause menu with Resume is visible and clickable.
At 0 lives the Game over dialog appears with a Retry button that is clickable.
checks.expect: cur.state.lives == 0 && any(cur.ui, u => u.id == 'btn-retry' && u.visible && u.top)

checks.rule: Every visible button must be clickable: nothing may cover it.

value.notes: Round 1: no map or state observed yet, so these plans are exploratory. Priorities: (1) read the first state and HUD to confirm the start at (1,1), 3 lives, Coins 0/5, Dash ready, Time 300. (2) Check the input order inside a single tick, including pause mixed with a move. (3) Check the Dash recharge of 6, which should show 'Dash 5' right after a dash and 'Dash ready' after 6 running ticks. (4) Check that paused ticks freeze the timer, the recharge and toasts. Next round, use the observed tiles to plan a goto path to the coins, keys, the lever and the exit.

plans.purpose: Fresh start: confirm HUD text and state after each basic step, dash recharge countdown from 6 to ready, and pause freezing the timer.
Same-tick input order and single-move rule: several move keys in one tick, pause mixed with a move, and Enter closing the menu.
Boundary of lives and timer: walk into the nearest enemy path and bump walls, then pause and restart the level to check the reset state.

Check each score delta against the item table: coin +100, gem +5000, relic +20000, spikes -500 (floored at 0), heart +1 life or +500 at 5 lives. Also check that the time bonus is 10 per tick left.

verdicts.title: HUD Coins stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin by dash
verdicts.observed: After dash-right at tick 2, state shows coins=1 and Score 100, but the HUD still reads 'Coins 0/5'.
verdicts.expected: HUD shows current values: Coins should read 1/5 right after the coin is collected.

verdicts.title: HUD Time lags one tick behind the timer after resuming from pause
verdicts.observed: After pause+right then click:btn-resume, state timeLeft is 299 but the HUD reads 'Time 300'.
verdicts.expected: HUD shows the current timer value (ticks left), i.e. 299 once the running tick has dropped the timer.

verdicts.title: Restart level from pause leaves the game paused instead of running
verdicts.observed: After pause then click:btn-restart, state resets to score 0/lives 3/time 300 but mode stays 'paused' and the pause menu remains; further waits change nothing.
verdicts.expected: Restart level puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away (mode 'playing').

verdicts.title: Spikes subtract 500 from score 100 and wrap to 65136
verdicts.observed: Stepping on spikes with score 100 sets score to 65136 (unsigned underflow of 100-500) and lives drop to 2.
verdicts.expected: Spikes cost 500 points with the score floored at 0, so score should be 0 and lives 2.

verdicts.title: Dash and step pressed in same tick both move the player (3 tiles)
verdicts.observed: Tick dash-right+right moves the player from (1,1) to (4,1): a 2-tile dash plus a 1-tile step in one tick.
verdicts.expected: Only the last movement key counts; the player makes at most one move (a step or a dash) per tick, so the player should end at (2,1).

verdicts.title: Score goes negative (-300) after spikes underflow
verdicts.observed: After the spike hit the score is 65136 and then shows -300 in the HUD at tick 5 (pause+right) and stays negative on resume.
verdicts.expected: Score is never negative; spikes floor the score at 0 and it must stay within 0..999,999.

verdicts.title: Spikes at score 100 make score jump to 65136, then go negative (-300)
verdicts.observed: At tick 2 a spike hit with score 100 raised the score to 65136 instead of flooring at 0. Later, at tick 5, the score fell to -300 with no spikes event, and it stayed negative after coins were collected.
verdicts.expected: Spikes cost 500 points, but the score never goes below 0 and is never negative. Score 100 minus a spike hit should give 0, not 65136 or -300.

verdicts.title: Pause menu Resume button covered by toast, so it is not clickable
verdicts.observed: After pausing, btn-resume reports top=false while the 'Key collected' toast is still visible. Something sits on top of the Resume button.
verdicts.expected: Every visible button must be clickable and nothing may cover it. The Resume button in the pause menu must be on top.

verdicts.title: Enemy overlap at tick 9 is inside the post-respawn invulnerability window
verdicts.observed: Respawn at tick 5 set invulnerable to 4. Ticks 6, 7, 8 and 9 are the 4 protected ticks, and the contact at tick 9 happened while protection was still active. The check reads the post-countdown value of 0, which is off by one.
verdicts.expected: No life is lost during the 4 ticks after respawn, so no hit at tick 9 is correct. This is a false positive.

verdicts.title: Coin score check misfires on restart
verdicts.observed: The violation is at tick 12, where the 'restart' event resets the score from 64136 to 0. The check's exclusion list omits 'restart', so the score drop is flagged. The restart itself behaves as designed.
verdicts.expected: Restart resets the score to 0 by design, so this is a check flaw. The underlying score overflow is covered by candidate 6.

verdicts.title: HUD Coins stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin
verdicts.observed: After dash-down collected a coin, state.coins is 1 but the HUD shows 'Coins 0/5' on the same tick and after the next tick.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

verdicts.title: HUD Time lags one tick behind the timer
verdicts.observed: After resume, state.timeLeft is 299 but the HUD still shows 'Time 300'. The HUD keeps showing the previous value.
verdicts.expected: The HUD shows the current ticks left on the timer, so it should read 'Time 299' to match state.timeLeft.

verdicts.title: Spikes drive score to 65136 instead of clamping at 0
verdicts.observed: At tick 2 the player on 100 points hits spikes; score becomes 65136 (100 - 500 wrapped as unsigned 16-bit) while lives correctly drop 3 to 2.
verdicts.expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score never goes below 0, so score should be 0 after the hit (max(100 - 500, 0)). Lives 3 to 2 is correct.

verdicts.title: Score goes negative (-32746) on level completion after wrap
verdicts.observed: Score wraps to 65136 after an earlier spike hit; the time bonus of 2590 then gives score -32746 at completion.
verdicts.expected: Score is never negative and capped at 999,999; it should be a small positive value (about 32,790 plus bonus) with spikes clamped at 0.

verdicts.title: Score silently drops from 65136 to -300 on a coin pickup
verdicts.observed: At tick 8 a coin is collected with no spikes or restart, yet score goes from 65136 to -300.
verdicts.expected: Score should only decrease through spikes or restart, and never below 0. A coin adds 100 to a valid score, so it should not drop at all.

verdicts.title: Level-complete Finish button covered by overlay
verdicts.observed: At tick 39, on the Level complete dialog, btn-next (Finish) is visible but top=false, so something (the bonus banner or toast) covers it and clicks would not reach it.
verdicts.expected: Every visible button must be clickable; nothing may cover the Finish button.

verdicts.title: Score negative (-32746) at level completion, same wrap bug
verdicts.observed: Same sequence as the score overflow case: after an earlier spike wrap, the time bonus pushes score to -32746 at completion; Enter then shows victory with negative score.
verdicts.expected: Score must stay within 0 to 999,999; spikes should clamp at 0 rather than wrap.

verdicts.title: Score shows -300 after spike wrap and coin pickup
verdicts.observed: Spikes at tick 3 turn score 100 into 65136; at tick 5 a coin then gives score -300.
verdicts.expected: Score is never negative; spikes should clamp at 0 (score 0), and a coin adds 100 to a non-negative score.
